model.focalRelation: Supply-chain risk requirements constrain acquired-software evidence, while system lifecycle traceability constrains the secure SDLC’s build and release gates. Evidence remains valid for the subject it actually observed; a changed build needs new bound evidence.

lanes.label: Governed requirements

lanes.label: Immutable build subjects
lanes.rule: Bind SBOM, provenance, tests, and approval to an artifact digest and dependency graph.

lanes.label: Lifecycle change
lanes.rule: A changed dependency creates a changed build even when the product name is unchanged.

lanes.label: Evidence ledger
lanes.rule: Retain history; never relabel prior evidence as if it observed new bytes.

model.scenario: Build 418 of a claims service passed composition analysis, security tests, provenance verification, and deployment approval using library version 3.4. Before release, an automated update changes the library to 3.5 and creates build 419. The supplier is the same, but artifact digest, dependency graph, and executable build have changed.
